title: Definitely recommend!
text: A very informative & fun walk! Very cool to explore the architectural history of Barcelona to understand how it came to be today
author: George H

title: La SAGRADA must do
text: Amazing experience to enter La SAGRADA basilica and see the work of the crazy genius Gaudi. Our tour guide Gemma was knowledgeable and informative. Would highly recommended this tour if you are in Barcelona. It’s a must we also ascended the Nativity tower which was yet another view of Gaudis work and the city of Barcelona.
author: 4slights

title: Top!
text:
The tour was great, our tour guide, a local, blended a perfect mix of history, stories, personal experiences and humor into a unique experience (thank you, Christian C.!)
We were so excited that we signed up for the next tour the very next day:)
author: annesI3008NX

title: Between one and two hours of admiration but essential to avoid crowding to enjoy it quietly
text:
Impressive but I recommend checking the Maritime Station website to go the day fewer cruises arrive to Barcelona. Also go to lunchtime and avoid crowding.
Convenient to go up by elevator to the top of one of the towers and make the descent by. The spiral staircase inside De la Torre.
author: icano

title: Gaudi and Holy Family
text: Very interesting , our guide of Russian origin made his presentation very professional. We spent a very interesting afternoon.
author: 428ivonneg

title: Great tour around the Gaudi sights
text: Dominika was a great tour guide. We really enjoyed the tour, and learnt some interesting things that we wouldn't have by just looking at the sights. Would definitely recommend. There were only about 7 of us on the tour, if it had been full it would have been hard to hear with all the noise of the city.
author: SarahW8758

title: The accidental tour
text: Stumbled on the tour by accident while looking online for what to do in the city. The tour guide was very knowledgeable and passionate about the city. He added fun and drama to the experience, it was a lovely 2+hours
author: Ibidun_A

title: Worth the time and money
text: A great time walking around and hearing about the history of one for the most famous places in the world. We found the tour very informative and friendly. Worth the time and money
author: robbH2401EK

title: Best tour and guide ever!
text: Please request Natalia! She was the BEST tour guide I have ever had in any tour in any country I have taken! She was passionate, knowledgeable, and very fluent in English and Barcelona  history!
